filteringEnabled.title: Enable Clearway filtering
filteringEnabled.description: When false, Clearway does not install block rules.

blockDomains.title: Additional blocked domains
blockDomains.description: DNS names such as example.org or *.example.org.

allowDomains.title: Allowed domains
allowDomains.description: Domains exempted from Clearway domain and URL rules.

blockedUrlFilters.title: Blocked URL filters
blockedUrlFilters.description: Declarative Net Request urlFilter expressions; see admin guide.

blockedUrlKeywords.title: Blocked URL keywords
blockedUrlKeywords.description: Words matched anywhere in the URL, not the visible page text.

enablePageKeywordBlocking.title: Enable page text keyword blocking
enablePageKeywordBlocking.description: Enable best-effort DOM inspection and a local overlay.

pageKeywords.title: Blocked page text keywords
pageKeywords.description: Text checked in page title, headings and an initial body text sample.

organizationName.title: Organisation name
organizationName.description: Name shown on the ClearWay restriction page.

supportUrl.title: IT support URL
supportUrl.description: HTTPS or HTTP helpdesk link shown on the restriction page.

enabledCategories.title: Enabled filtering categories
enabledCategories.description: Category names enabled for this organisation; matched against category feed names.

categoryFeedUrls.title: Category list feed URLs
categoryFeedUrls.description: HTTPS JSON feeds with a categories object mapping category names to domain arrays.

blacklistDomains.title: Organisation blacklist
blacklistDomains.description: Domains blocked specifically by this organisation.

whitelistDomains.title: Organisation whitelist
whitelistDomains.description: Domains allowed by this organisation; takes priority over domain rules.

blockedKeywords.title: Organisation URL keywords
blockedKeywords.description: Keywords matched in URLs for this organisation.

blockYouTubeEntirely.title: Block YouTube entirely
blockYouTubeEntirely.description: Blocks YouTube as a separate control; use video IDs for selective blocking instead.

blockedYouTubeVideoIds.title: Blocked YouTube video IDs
blockedYouTubeVideoIds.description: Blocks specific YouTube videos by video ID, including watch, shorts and youtu.be URLs.

categoryKeywords.title: Category-specific page keywords
categoryKeywords.description: Entries formatted category|keyword; applied only when that category is enabled.

categoryLookupApiUrl.title: Category lookup API URL
categoryLookupApiUrl.description: Optional HTTPS endpoint checked after a page loads; receives only the hostname as a domain query parameter.
